title: tooltips clarify outcomes
name: Tooltips clarify outcomes — NN/g
rule: When an icon or button initiates an action, include a tooltip that states the outcome without conflicting with the visible label.
pass_when: An action-initiating icon or button has a tooltip that states the outcome and does not conflict with the visible label.
fail_when: No tooltip on that control, or the tooltip conflicts with the visible label.
overview: Action icons and buttons get tooltips that state outcome without conflict.
apply_when: An icon or button initiates an action and needs outcome clarification.
not_when: Decorative icons that initiate no action and need no outcome tooltip.
agent_hint: Add an outcome tooltip that agrees with the visible label on action controls.
description: When an icon or button starts an action, a tooltip should state the outcome and must not conflict with the visible label. Missing tooltips leave icon meaning to guesswork, especially for uncommon metaphors. Conflicting tooltip copy creates distrust because two names compete for the same control. Use outcome tooltips on actionable controls; skip them on purely decorative marks that initiate nothing.
